overview_description.description: MESH is a nationally recognized full-service marketing and advertising agency pecializing in branding, advertising, digital and web based marketing. Founded in 2003 by CEO and Chief Creative Officer, Taylor Bennett, MESH has a team of over 35 talented professionals. We have proven expertise in a variety of industries including professional services, healthcare, education, building materials, travel and hospitality and consumer packaged goods-to name a few. With skilled and experienced brand management, and strategic and creative disciplines, we provide results-driven solutions that can help achieve your business objectives.
